Get SSD speeds and inject new life into your laptop or desktop PC with a solid state drive from Inland Performance. ## Next-level SSD Performance

 Unleash the power of the INLAND PERFORMANCE PLUS PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD for next-level computing. Get read/ write speeds up to 7,000 MB/s and 5,500 MB/s, pushing the limits of what SSDs can do. With a PCIe 4.0 interface 2x faster than PCIe 3.0 SSDs and 12x faster than SATA, backward compatible with PCIe 3.0.

Experience INLAND Performance Plus GEN 4 Speed

With INLAND PERFORMANCE PLUS 1TB PCIe Gen 4.0 x 4 SSD, enjoy a new level of gaming performance, experience lightning bootup and shutdown, and quicker application response and data transfer speeds. Ideal for gamers, overclockers, and PC enthusiasts. 3D TLC NAND Memory up to 700 TBW Provides an ideal mix of performance, endurance, and value to keep your drive performing at its best.
